segments.text: Then Job answered,
“I have heard many such things. You are all miserable comforters!
segments.speaker: Job

segments.text: Shall vain words have an end? Or what provokes you that you answer?
segments.speaker: Job

segments.text: I also could speak as you do. If your soul were in my soul’s place,
segments.speaker: Job

segments.text:
I could join words together against you,
and shake my head at you,
segments.speaker: Job

segments.text: but I would strengthen you with my mouth. The solace of my lips would relieve you.
segments.speaker: Job

segments.text: “Though I speak, my grief is not subsided. Though I forbear, what am I eased?
segments.speaker: Job

segments.text: But now, God, you have surely worn me out. You have made all my company desolate.
segments.speaker: Job

segments.text: You have shriveled me up. This is a witness against me. My leanness rises up against me.
segments.speaker: Job

segments.text: It testifies to my face.
segments.speaker: Job

segments.text: He has torn me in his wrath and persecuted me. He has gnashed on me with his teeth.
segments.speaker: Job

segments.text: My adversary sharpens his eyes on me.
segments.speaker: Job

segments.text: They have gaped on me with their mouth. They have struck me on the cheek reproachfully.
segments.speaker: Job

segments.text: They gather themselves together against me.
segments.speaker: Job

segments.text: God delivers me to the ungodly, and casts me into the hands of the wicked.
segments.speaker: Job

segments.text: I was at ease, and he broke me apart. Yes, he has taken me by the neck, and dashed me to pieces.
segments.speaker: Job

segments.text: He has also set me up for his target.
segments.speaker: Job

segments.text: His archers surround me. He splits my kidneys apart, and does not spare.
segments.speaker: Job

segments.text: He pours out my bile on the ground.
segments.speaker: Job

segments.text: He breaks me with breach on breach. He runs at me like a giant.
segments.speaker: Job

segments.text: I have sewed sackcloth on my skin, and have thrust my horn in the dust.
segments.speaker: Job

segments.text: My face is red with weeping. Deep darkness is on my eyelids,
segments.speaker: Job

segments.text: although there is no violence in my hands, and my prayer is pure.
segments.speaker: Job

segments.text: “Earth, don’t cover my blood. Let my cry have no place to rest.
segments.speaker: Job

segments.text: Even now, behold, my witness is in heaven. He who vouches for me is on high.
segments.speaker: Job

segments.text: My friends scoff at me. My eyes pour out tears to God,
segments.speaker: Job

segments.text: that he would maintain the right of a man with God, of a son of man with his neighbor!
segments.speaker: Job

segments.text: For when a few years have come, I will go the way of no return.
segments.speaker: Job
